relations: The stationary silver boombox remains centered on the paved boardwalk while the camera stays fixed.
The gold-skated skater moves behind the boombox to the right, and the white-skated skater glides leftward across the front.
As the skaters swap positions, their passing legs alternately occlude the round speakers.
The gold-skated skater tilts a skate upward and rests it against the front face, covering the left speaker.
caption: The video captures a silver ION boombox with a central cassette deck and two round speakers sitting stationary on a flat paved boardwalk, framed by palm trunks, lamp posts and low buildings. Two roller-skating people move around it: one in ripped light-blue jeans with gold skates and pale-yellow wheels, the other in pink-camo shorts, black socks and white skates with pink wheels. The camera stays fixed on the boombox, which remains centered and unmoved as the skating process continues through the excerpt. The gold-skated skater, already rolling on the left, moves behind the boombox and reappears on the right, while the white-skated skater enters at the right edge and glides leftward across the front, the two swapping positions and alternately occluding the speakers. Throughout this exchange the boombox stays fixed, its surface only intermittently blocked by passing legs. As the white skater settles on the left, the gold skater extends a leg, tilting one skate upward with the toe pick raised. That tilted skate then rolls in to rest against the front face, covering the left speaker through the excerpt's final moments.
